answer: One workable design: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because forge only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, whisper is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any vine approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
